args:
# python:3.13-bookworm already ships g++, git, curl and tar (probed
# 2026-07-28 against this exact image). Re-installing them cost ~6s of
# apt work on EVERY validate run. Assert instead of install: ci-local.sh
# SKIPS the twin g++ compile when the compiler is absent, so a missing
# toolchain must fail loudly here rather than silently drop a gate.
for tool in g++ git curl tar; do
  command -v "$tool" >/dev/null || { echo "CI image is missing $tool" >&2; exit 1; }
done
curl -sSLo /usr/local/bin/kustomize.tgz "https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kustomize/releases/download/kustomize%2Fv5.4.3/kustomize_v5.4.3_linux_amd64.tar.gz" \
  && tar -xzf /usr/local/bin/kustomize.tgz -C /usr/local/bin kustomize && rm /usr/local/bin/kustomize.tgz
cd /workspace/repo
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "${REVISION}"
if [ "$(cat /impact/mode)" = skip ]; then exit 0; fi
if [ "$CLASSIFY_PUSH" = true ] && ! git cat-file -e "${CI_BASE_REF}^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then
  unset CI_BASE_REF
fi
# No editable install (pyproject has no build-system); pull the dep
# lists straight from pyproject like the retired GH job did.
python - <<'PY' > /tmp/reqs.txt
import tomllib
d = tomllib.load(open("pyproject.toml", "rb"))
reqs = list(d["project"]["dependencies"])
opt = d["project"].get("optional-dependencies", {})
for grp in ("dev", "planner", "api"):
    reqs += opt.get(grp, [])
print("\n".join(reqs))
PY
python -m venv .venv
.venv/bin/pip -q install -r /tmp/reqs.txt paho-mqtt 'mcp[cli]' pydantic-settings pytest pytest-asyncio
bash scripts/ci-local.sh

# ruby:3.3-alpine ships Ruby (for the App-token mint) but not Git or CA roots.
apk add --no-cache ca-certificates git python3 >/dev/null

case "$REVISION" in
  *[!0-9a-f]*|'') echo "revision must be a lowercase hex sha" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
test "${#REVISION}" -eq 40
if [ -n "$BASE_REVISION" ]; then
  case "$BASE_REVISION" in
    *[!0-9a-f]*) echo "base revision must be a lowercase hex sha" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
  test "${#BASE_REVISION}" -eq 40
fi
umask 077
git_auth_dir="$(mktemp -d /tmp/git-auth.XXXXXX)"
git_token_file="${git_auth_dir}/token"
git_credential_file="${git_auth_dir}/credential-helper.sh"
cleanup_git_auth() {
  rm -f "${git_token_file}" "${git_credential_file}"
  rmdir "${git_auth_dir}" 2>/dev/null || true
}
trap cleanup_git_auth EXIT
# #3263: mint the short-lived, repository-restricted, read-only installation
# token instead of reading the caller-selected Secret (agent-github-token —
# DELETED by #3208, and the #3209 exfiltration vector). Owner-resolved
# installation: this is a VerdifyConsultancy repository while the committed
# Secret's installation_id is jvallery's. GitHub's repositories[] field wants
# the BARE repo name — a ".git" suffix 422s (#3267).
export REPO_OWNER=VerdifyConsultancy
export REPO_NAME=verdify-platform
ruby -rbase64 -rjson -rnet/http -ropenssl -ruri <<'RUBY' > "$git_token_file"
def b64url(value)
  Base64.urlsafe_encode64(value).delete("=")
end

def request_json(uri, request)
  response = Net::HTTP.start(
    uri.host, uri.port, use_ssl: true, open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 20
  ) { |http| http.request(request) }
  abort "GitHub App request failed: #{response.code}" unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
  JSON.parse(response.body)
end

def github_request(klass, uri, jwt)
  request = klass.new(uri)
  request["Accept"] = "application/vnd.github+json"
  request["Authorization"] = "Bearer #{jwt}"
  request["User-Agent"] = "agent-fleet-ci-verdify-platform-validate"
  request["X-GitHub-Api-Version"] = "2022-11-28"
  request
end

app_id = File.read("/var/run/secrets/github-app/app_id").strip
private_key = OpenSSL::PKey::RSA.new(
  File.read("/var/run/secrets/github-app/private_key")
)
owner = ENV.fetch("REPO_OWNER")
repository = ENV.fetch("REPO_NAME")
now = Time.now.to_i
header = { alg: "RS256", typ: "JWT" }
payload = { iat: now - 60, exp: now + 540, iss: app_id }
signing_input = [header, payload].map { |part| b64url(JSON.generate(part)) }.join(".")
signature = private_key.sign(OpenSSL::Digest.new("SHA256"), signing_input)
jwt = "#{signing_input}.#{b64url(signature)}"

installations = request_json(
  URI("https://api.github.com/app/installations?per_page=100"),
  github_request(Net::HTTP::Get, URI("https://api.github.com/app/installations?per_page=100"), jwt)
)
installation = installations.find { |row| row.dig("account", "login").to_s.casecmp?(owner) }
abort "no CI App installation for owner #{owner}" unless installation

token_uri = URI("https://api.github.com/app/installations/#{installation.fetch('id')}/access_tokens")
token_request = github_request(Net::HTTP::Post, token_uri, jwt)
token_request["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
token_request.body = JSON.generate(
  repositories: [repository],
  permissions: { contents: "read", metadata: "read" }
)
token = request_json(token_uri, token_request).fetch("token")
abort "GitHub App returned an empty installation token" if token.empty?
puts token
RUBY
cat > "$git_credential_file" <<'GIT_CREDENTIAL_HELPER_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
[ "${1:-}" = get ] || exit 0
protocol=
host=
protocol_seen=0
host_seen=0
while IFS= read -r line; do
  case "$line" in
    protocol=*)
      [ "$protocol_seen" -eq 0 ] || exit 0
      protocol="${line#protocol=}"
      protocol_seen=1
      ;;
    host=*)
      [ "$host_seen" -eq 0 ] || exit 0
      host="${line#host=}"
      host_seen=1
      ;;
    '') break ;;
  esac
done
[ "$protocol_seen" -eq 1 ] && [ "$protocol" = https ] || exit 0
[ "$host_seen" -eq 1 ] && [ "$host" = github.com ] || exit 0
IFS= read -r credential < "$GIT_TOKEN_FILE" || exit 1
printf 'username=x-access-token\n'
printf 'password=%s\n\n' "$credential"
GIT_CREDENTIAL_HELPER_EOF
chmod 0600 "$git_token_file"
chmod 0700 "$git_credential_file"
export GIT_TOKEN_FILE="$git_token_file"
export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
unset GIT_ASKPASS SSH_ASKPASS
git_with_github_auth() {
  git -c credential.helper= \
    -c "credential.helper=${git_credential_file}" "$@"
}
rm -rf /workspace/repo
# No partial-clone filter: the secret-free validation container
# must never need a lazy authenticated fetch while inspecting
# the base or head revision.
git_with_github_auth clone --quiet --no-tags \
  "https://github.com/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform.git" /workspace/repo
git_with_github_auth -C /workspace/repo fetch --quiet --no-tags \
  origin "$REVISION"
if [ -n "$BASE_REVISION" ]; then
  if ! git_with_github_auth -C /workspace/repo fetch --quiet --no-tags origin "$BASE_REVISION"; then
    # A deleted/initial push base cannot justify skipping builds.
    # PR callers still fail closed rather than drop diff gates.
    [ "$CLASSIFY_PUSH" = true ] || exit 1
    BASE_REVISION=""
  fi
fi
git_with_github_auth -C /workspace/repo checkout --quiet --detach "$REVISION"
test "$(git_with_github_auth -C /workspace/repo rev-parse HEAD)" = "$REVISION"
cleanup_git_auth
trap - EXIT
unset GIT_TOKEN_FILE GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT REPO_OWNER REPO_NAME
unset -f git_with_github_auth cleanup_git_auth
# Trusted init interprets source only as data. The result volume
# is read-only in the subsequent repository-code container.
if [ "$CLASSIFY_PUSH" = true ]; then
  python3 /opt/verdify-ci/impact.py --root /workspace/repo \
    --head "$REVISION" --base "$BASE_REVISION" --output /impact --push
else
  python3 /opt/verdify-ci/impact.py --root /workspace/repo \
    --head "$REVISION" --base "$BASE_REVISION" --output /impact
fi
initContainers.name: fetch-validate-context

args:
# ruby:3.3-alpine ships Ruby (for the App-token mint) but not curl or CA roots.
apk add --no-cache ca-certificates curl >/dev/null
case "$REVISION" in *[!0-9a-f]*|'') exit 1 ;; esac
[ "${#REVISION}" -eq 40 ]
validation_event=PR
[ "$EVENT_ACTION" != push ] || validation_event=main
case "$STATUS_STATE" in
  pending)
    api_state=pending
    description="Verdify Platform in-cluster ${validation_event} validation started"
    ;;
  Succeeded)
    api_state=success
    description="Verdify Platform in-cluster ${validation_event} validation passed"
    ;;
  *)
    # Failed, Error, or an unexpected terminal state must never false-green.
    api_state=failure
    description="Verdify Platform in-cluster ${validation_event} validation failed"
    ;;
esac
umask 077
github_auth_dir="$(mktemp -d /tmp/github-auth.XXXXXX)"
github_token_file="${github_auth_dir}/token"
github_header_file="${github_auth_dir}/github-header"
cleanup_github_auth() {
  rm -f "${github_token_file}" "${github_header_file}"
  rmdir "${github_auth_dir}" 2>/dev/null || true
}
trap cleanup_github_auth EXIT
cp /var/run/secrets/repo-auth/token "$github_token_file"
test -s "$github_token_file"
# The API header file is derived from the private token file without the
# token ever entering an environment variable or process argv.
{ printf 'Authorization: Bearer '; cat "$github_token_file"; } > "$github_header_file"
chmod 0600 "$github_token_file" "$github_header_file"
payload="$(printf '{"state":"%s","context":"Verdify Platform / Argo PR CI","description":"%s"}' \
  "$api_state" "$description")"
curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error \
  --request POST \
  --header "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
  --header "@${github_header_file}" \
  --header "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28" \
  --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data "$payload" \
  --output /tmp/github-status-response.json \
  "https://api.github.com/repos/VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform/statuses/${REVISION}"
echo "Verdify Platform PR commit status recorded."

script.source:
set -eu
fail() {
  echo "Verdify Platform validation precheck rejected the event or revision." >&2
  exit 1
}
is_sha() {
  value="$1"
  [ "${#value}" -eq 40 ] || return 1
  case "$value" in *[!0-9a-f]*|"") return 1 ;; esac
}
case "$EVENT_ACTION" in
  opened|reopened|synchronize) ;;
  push) [ "$HEAD_REF" = main ] || fail ;;
  *) fail ;;
esac
[ "$REPOSITORY" = "VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform" ] || fail
[ "$BASE_REPOSITORY" = "$REPOSITORY" ] || fail
[ "$HEAD_REPOSITORY" = "$REPOSITORY" ] || fail
[ "$BASE_REF" = main ] || fail
[ -n "$HEAD_REF" ] || fail
case "$HEAD_REF" in *[!A-Za-z0-9._/-]*|""|/*|*/|*..*) fail ;; esac
is_sha "$BASE_REVISION" || fail
is_sha "$HEAD_REVISION" || fail
printf full > /tmp/validation-mode
